authority: Research-only versioned mechanics/provenance contract. Existing released main/GameData.lua remains untouched until approved migration; future SINGLE bundled authoritative item/conversion database filename is exactly itemdb.lua.
purpose: Catalog expansion/recipe scoped mechanics, provenance, exact live API availability, historical patches and numerical correction evidence for selecting one current-Retail condition-labelled reference baseline. Unknown effects BLOCK normalization; no executable formulas are verified.

baselinePolicy.definition: ONE selected source-backed and explicitly context-labelled baseline per input/output recipe and target Retail patch; baseline is not necessarily low skill or maximum skill

fieldDefinitions.dropChance: P(at least one output unit in one operation), fraction 0..1
fieldDefinitions.yieldMin: minimum whole-number output units CONDITIONED on output occurring; observed sample limit is not proven game minimum
fieldDefinitions.yieldMax: maximum whole-number output units CONDITIONED on output occurring; observed sample limit is not proven game maximum
fieldDefinitions.expectedQuantity: UNCONDITIONAL decimal average units per operation including zero; ONLY this output quantity is used in pricing

baselinePolicy.independentEvidence: Separate evidence/confidence/source per field, and separate numeric formula confidence for any transformation
prohibited: silently pool pre- and post-hotfix samples
use one output's multipliers for another output without evidence
baselinePolicy.personalObservations: SavedVariables observations are independent empirical evidence, not a second shipped built-in yield table
baselinePolicy.additionalMeasuredCohorts: Preserve any number of condition-stratified raw samples separately under research/evidence; do not require duplicated LOW/HIGH output tables in GameData.lua
baselinePolicy.statisticalDistribution: Four summary fields suffice for baseline tooltip/EV but cannot infer arbitrary nonlinear context transformations. Retain zero-inclusive per-cast histograms or full records in the evidence archive whenever available.
baselinePolicy.zeroAndUnknown: A proven impossible output or measured zero has value 0; unavailable context or unobserved output is null (unknown), never silently coerce nil to 0.
baselinePolicy.normalizationRequired: Only verified patch/recipe/output-specific transforms may create a current Retail or simulated baseline from mismatched samples; do not treat missing rules as identity transforms.
baselinePolicy.separateOutputAndInputEffects: Changes to output occurrence/expected quantity, input refunds, crafting quality, eligibility and time must be modeled in separate dimensions; never multiply a cost adjustment into material drop quantity.

observationContextSchema.unknownValue: Use null, not zero, when a sample does not disclose the condition
observationContextSchema.note: Raw total / actual eligible operations establishes an empirical unconditional mean only; without per-cast hit counts it cannot establish P(drop) or conditional yield limits.
observationContextSchema.requiredDoesNotMeanKnown: These fields must be present as schema keys, but may explicitly contain null with an unknown reason; missing is not equivalent to zero skill or no specialization.

normalizationProtocol.target: Current Retail 2026 with a precise target patch and target real/simulated profession context
steps: Verify input/output identity, operation/batch normalization, eligible recipe and expansion.
Record original study's date, patch, skill, gear, specialization, stats, input/output quality, and game mode; never substitute missing facts with zero.
Locate all patch events between sample and target; if one affecting output has unknown numeric effect, mark output adjustment unconvertible.
Match each documented specialization or stat against its recipe and output. Transform ONLY fields whose causal changes and numerical coefficients are supported.
Maintain per-field confidence and transform confidence separately; never upgrade sample evidence confidence just because a formula runs.

If transformation is unavailable, preserve the original context-specific observation; select a current-version measurement or explicitly labeled reference fallback without claiming mathematically normalized current rates.

allowedMethods.formula: E_per_operation = units_observed_total / completed_operations OR E_per_input * verified_batch_size

allowedMethods.requires: validated strictly positive multiplicative factors for this specific output and conditions; cannot use if the effect changes eligibility, quality bins or distribution nonmultiplicatively
independently measured recipe-specific rank/quality mapping; never sum competing output ranks
documented recipe eligibility, stat probability and saving count; output expected quantity remains separate
verified patch-specific per-output transformation. Otherwise BLOCKED_NUMERIC_UNKNOWN

normalizationProtocol.noActionWhenUnknown: Do not normalize using an arbitrary patch multiplier, low/high midpoint, universal 0-100 skill slope or unrelated profession stat.
normalizationProtocol.separateFieldReview: P(drop), conditional min, conditional max and unconditional E each require their own transformation evidence.

numericModelResearchProgram.scopePolicy: Exact Retail patch/build, recipeSpellID, input/output item IDs/rank sets, batch size and character context; no wildcard inheritance across recipes, patches, expansions or material family.
numericModelResearchProgram.approvalPolicy: Promote only VERIFIED_NUMERIC with independently checked original numeric sources, >=90 evidence confidence, exact applicability, numerically validated formula, all dependent runtime context, master approval and passing test; do not upgrade output baseline confidence.
numericModelResearchProgram.formulaRuntimePolicy: Formula implementation remains in ConversionEngine.lua; rules/parameters may be generated in single future itemdb.lua after review. Registry and raw studies are NOT shipped. Missing context must fail closed.
numericModelResearchProgram.patchPolicy: Never normalize an unknown numeric hotfix, including 2026-03-31 Midnight gems. Unknown ratio is BLOCKED, not x1.
numericModelResearchProgram.inputCosts: Resourcefulness adjusts expected input consumption after verified recipe and reagent-savings statistics, not material output expected quantity.
numericModelResearchProgram.releaseBoundary: No addon Lua, main branch, or TOC change without separate user approval and regression/in-client tests.

hypothesisResearchPriorities.question: Can same-recipe, same-ore, same-quality, same-skill pre/post March 31 observations establish each affected gem-specific change without extrapolating byproducts?
For exact eligible TWW prospect recipe, which observed proc chance and saved reagent counts determine effective ore consumption?
Which Dragonflight prospect recipes and skill thresholds did Inspiration actually change, with observed output-rank transition counts?
Are five-ore standard and twenty-ore mass Felslate prospecting separate operations with matching or different output distribution after strict denominator normalization?

numericNonPromotionInvariants: Never ship a rule solely because a JSON field says VERIFIED_NUMERIC; the compiler MUST independently validate scope, sources, evidence and test provenance.
Never take range midpoints or multiply unconditional expectedQuantity by dropChance.
Never map inferred quality/unlock to an output not verified for that exact recipe.
Never equate no measured difference with verified no-effect without powered controlled evidence.
A numerical mechanism cannot make an unverified baseline output record >=90 confidence.
A rule concerning pricing/input savings is not a material drop-quantity adjustment.
